question: The half-life of a radioactive element is 140 days. After how many days will 16 g of this element reduce to 1 g?
explanation: 16 g to 1 g means 4 half-lives pass (16 → 8 → 4 → 2 → 1). Total time = 4 × 140 = 560 days.
